item.description: arXiv:2610.26652v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In the standard cosmological paradigm, the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum from a cosmic string network is well defined. item.title: Parity-odd CMB Correlations induced by a Chiral Gravitational Wave Background
item.description: arXiv:2610.29182v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate weak lensing effects of a chiral gravitational wave background (GWB) as a new mechanism for generating parity-odd correlations in the cosmic microwave background (CMB).
